proposals.evidence: CDIAL 3865.1 khādati gives Prakrit khāaï, Hindi khānā, Punjabi khāṇā, Nepali khānu, Gujarati khāvũ and eastern khāibā/khāeb. Only simple verb/infinitive forms are selected here; past stems belonging to khādita and khā-le completive constructions require separate analysis.
